cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Admit You’re Hurt
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit hurt, fear, or disappointment before you reveal that you feel it too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. When Mum cancelled our birthday dinner, were you disappointed?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I'd like your answer before I give mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. I cried in the supermarket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Me too. I told the cashier the birthday candles were seasonal allergies.
